fonts.display: 'denim', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'muoto', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: Forest Ink
palette.role: Primary text, icons, and chart strokes — the load-bearing dark color. Reads near-black but carries a cool green undertone that ties the monochrome system together

palette.name: Bone White
palette.role: Card surfaces, data point fills, and reverse text on dark blocks

palette.name: Sage Paper
palette.role: Page canvas and large background fields. A green-tinted light gray that gives the whole surface its herbarium character

palette.name: Ash Gray
palette.role: Alternate surface tone for nested blocks, inset panels, and subtle differentiation beneath cards

palette.name: Muted Sage
palette.role: Soft fill washes, scatter plot halos, and decorative surface tints that sit behind darker data marks

palette.name: Lichen
palette.role: Hairline borders, dotted gridlines, and chart axes. The structural line color when a neutral needs to be present without competing with text

palette.name: Slate Smoke
palette.role: Secondary metadata, icon strokes, and caption text where the body tone is too heavy

palette.name: Charcoal Bark
palette.role: Deep text, heavy borders, and dark surface blocks. Slightly warm-neutral, used for the rare dark panel and strong dividers

palette.name: Moss
palette.role: The single filled action color — primary buttons, active state fills, and the rare chromatic surface. A soft, slightly desaturated mint that does not shout against the sage canvas

palette.name: Deep Fern
palette.role: Green text accent for links, tags, and emphasized short phrases. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

palette.name: Pine
palette.role: Green text accent for links, tags, and emphasized short phrases. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

palette.name: Emerald
palette.role: Alternate data-mark fill and emphasis backgrounds, used on scatter plot points and callout chips

palette.name: Indigo Accent
palette.role: A single chromatic exception — used on one special link or annotation to break the green-only system. Employ rarely; treat as a punctuation mark, not a palette member
